answer:
The key government revenue streams are Corporate Income Tax, Personal Income Tax, Goods and Services Tax, and Net Investment Returns Contribution.

The Operating Revenue is estimated to be $108.6 billion (p.13) in FY2024, with an increase of $4.3 billion (p.13) over the Revised FY2023 Operating Revenue of $104.3 billion (p.13).

The Budget for the Future Energy Fund is $5.0 billion (p.20).

The document does not identify any specific revenue stream as funding the Budget for the Future Energy Fund. The Budget for the Future Energy Fund is part of the overall Budget, funded by the revenue streams of Corporate Income Tax (27.2% of Operating Revenue, p.9), Personal Income Tax (16.8% of Operating Revenue, p.9), Goods and Services Tax (15.7% of Operating Revenue, p.9), and Net Investment Returns Contribution ($23.5 billion, p.13).
